messages:
nisha: FYI rolled out Opal9b q4b quant to canary this morning. Seeing two issues: 1) short prompt repetition loops (same token repeated 3-6x) on ~5% of requests, 2) p99 latency up ~18-22% on canary. Repro steps and logs below.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: canary=opal9b-q4b-2026-03-20T08:12Z (sha: b7f2c3d) :white_check_mark:

lee: can you paste a failing prompt + output? also which quant backend (fused vs generic)?

nisha: failing prompt attached. quant backend = fused-4bit (nvfused patch). sample output: 
```
User: summarize: "refund policy for digital goods"
Model: The refund policy is as follows: Refunds are issued only on request. Refunds are issued... Refunds are issued... Refunds are issued...
```
repro CLI: `./tools/repro.sh --model opal9b-q4b --prompt "summarize: \"refund policy for digital goods\"" --max-tokens 64 --temp 0.0`
logs (canary node id 07c): `kv_cache miss ratio 0.12, step_ms=62, kv_append_ms=9, fused_attn_kernel=enabled`

sam: hmm KV cache miss looks low. latency bump could be due to kernel fallback thrash on short sequences. Repetition suggests attention matrix numerical instability after quantization. Did we run the int8->4bit calibration with mix-precision eval?

nisha: we used the standard q4b recipe from onboarding doc (calib on 1M tokens, per-channel). Perf/eval harness ran but sample size was small for short prompts.

maria: product has 3 customer tickets flagged this morning mentioning "weird repeated sentences" in billing flow. Impacting a small but paying cohort. Please priority-check. :exclamation:

lee: assigning triage steps: 1) reproduce locally with low-temp deterministic runs, 2) run fnmatch on attention weights for anomalies, 3) compare fused vs generic kernel outputs, 4) run full eval suite on short prompts. I'll take #1 & #3.

alex: I can run the eval sweep for short prompts across canary vs pre-q4 baseline. ETA 45m.

oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0319-opal9b-rep-loop, severity=medium, owner=eng-ml oncall

sam: quick test suggestion: try disabling fused_attn and re-run the same seed/output to check determinism. config snippet: 
```
engine:
  fused_attn: false
  kv_cache_mode: incremental
  seed: 42
```

nisha: ran that on node 07c — repetition disappears when fused_attn=false. outputs look coherent and latency p99 drops ~7%. attaching diff.

lee: great signal. two hypotheses: 1) fused kernel numerical issue with q4b scale/zero-point on short seqs, 2) kernel uses a different causal masking path causing replay. Need reproducer at op-level and minimal unit test.

sam: I'll open a runtime PR to add fuzz tests for small-seq fused_attn with q4b ranges and edge-case masking. Also will add a canary rollout hold until next patch.

maria: please add a short customer-facing note for CS with mitigation steps (disable fused_attn) and ETA for fix.

nisha: mitigation plan: pin canary back to opal9b-q4b-nofused (rollback) and block global rollout. doing rollback now.

deploy-bot: rollback started: reverting canary to opal9b-q4b-nofused (sha: a9c4b1)

alex: eval sweep shows failure rate on short prompts drops from 5.1% -> 0.2% with fused_attn off. perf delta: p99 -18% -> -11% (i.e. improved vs canary). uploading results to /evals/opal9b/2026-03-20/short-prompts.csv

lee: next actions: (A) runtime to add unit + regression tests (sam), (B) eng-ml to run numerics audit of fused kernel (nisha+lee), (C) product/CS note (maria), (D) hold global rollout until tests green (sam). owners noted.

nisha: thanks. I'll collect failing seeds and push a minimal repro harness to PR. tagging @sam when it's ready.

sam: noted. I'll block rollout and add a canary gate requiring fused_attn q4b regression <0.5% on short prompts.

maria: added CS template and sent initial heads-up to affected customers.

lee: nice. if anyone finds a quick patch we can hotfix fused kernel, otherwise keep fused disabled for q4b until we've audited.

alex: uploading additional logs and a small batch of token-level diffs to the incident ticket now.

nisha: thanks all — I'll update the incident ticket with repro artifacts and next update at +2h.
